viewers_reference_editorconfig_charset: Plain-language meaning of the charset key of an .editorconfig.
viewers_reference_editorconfig_end_of_li: Plain-language meaning of the end_of_line key of an .editorconfig. lf, crlf and cr are the values.
viewers_reference_editorconfig_indent_si: Plain-language meaning of the indent_size key of an .editorconfig.
viewers_reference_editorconfig_indent_st: Plain-language meaning of the indent_style key of an .editorconfig, under the key in the viewer.
viewers_reference_editorconfig_insert_fi: Plain-language meaning of the insert_final_newline key of an .editorconfig.
viewers_reference_editorconfig_max_line_: Plain-language meaning of the max_line_length key of an .editorconfig.
viewers_reference_editorconfig_tab_width: Plain-language meaning of the tab_width key of an .editorconfig.
viewers_reference_editorconfig_trim_trai: Plain-language meaning of the trim_trailing_whitespace key of an .editorconfig.
viewers_reference_license_any_use: Chip in the license view: no restriction.
viewers_reference_license_commercial_use: Chip in the license view: what the license allows.
viewers_reference_license_copyleft_share: Chip in the license view: derived work must publish its source under the same terms.
viewers_reference_license_distribution: Chip in the license view: what the license allows.
viewers_reference_license_file_level_cop: Chip in the license view (MPL): the copyleft applies to modified files, not to the whole work.
viewers_reference_license_keep_notice: Chip in the license view: the copyright and license notice must stay with copies.
viewers_reference_license_link_from_any_: Chip in the license view (LGPL): other code, under any license, may link to the library.
viewers_reference_license_modification: Chip in the license view: what the license allows.
viewers_reference_license_network_copyle: Chip in the license view (AGPL): offering the software over a network counts as distribution.
viewers_reference_license_no_endorsement: Chip in the license view: the authors' names may not be used to promote derived work.
viewers_reference_license_patent_grant: Chip in the license view: contributors grant a patent license.
viewers_reference_license_private_use: Chip in the license view: what the license allows.
viewers_reference_license_public_domain_: Chip in the license view (CC0): the author dedicates the work to the public domain.
viewers_reference_license_same_license: Chip in the license view: derived work must use the same license.
viewers_reference_license_share_library_: Chip in the license view (LGPL): changes to the library itself must be shared.
viewers_reference_license_share_source: Chip in the license view: the source must be made available to users.
viewers_reference_license_state_changes: Chip in the license view: modified files must say they were changed.
viewers_reference_license_unrecognized: Title of the license view when the text matches none of the licenses Atlas knows.
viewers_reference_manifest_build_backend: Label of the chip for the build backend of a pyproject.toml.
viewers_reference_manifest_edition: Label of the chip for the Rust edition of a Cargo.toml.
viewers_reference_manifest_engines: Label of the engines chip in the header of a package.json view: the Node versions the package supports (the engines field).
viewers_reference_manifest_homepage: Link in the header of a package manifest view that opens the homepage the manifest declares.
viewers_reference_manifest_main: Label of the chip for the main or module field of a package.json: the entry file.
viewers_reference_manifest_minimum_stabi: Label of the chip for the minimum-stability field of a composer.json.
viewers_reference_manifest_package_manag: Label of the chip that names the packageManager field of a package.json.
viewers_reference_manifest_private: Label of the chip that tells a package.json is marked private.
viewers_reference_manifest_replace: Label of a go.mod replace directive in the header of the go.mod view.
viewers_reference_manifest_repository: Link in the header of a package manifest view that opens the source repository the manifest declares.
viewers_reference_manifest_type: Label of the chip for the type field of a package.json or composer.json (module or commonjs, library or project).
viewers_reference_manifest_yes: Value of the Private chip of a package.json view.
